lastGame.title: Bills 33, Raiders 30
stats: Josh Allen: 255 pass yds, 2 TD — his 258th career TD pass ties Jim Kelly's Bills record
James Cook: 22 carries, 95 yds, TD + 3 catches for 58 yds
TD catches for Keon Coleman (shovel pass) and Khalil Shakir (9-yd screen)
Dorian Williams: first career interception, off Kirk Cousins
Tyler Bass 38-yd FG made it 33-23; Bills recovered the onside kick to close it

news.b: Appeals officer Jordy Nelson upheld C.J. Gardner-Johnson's one-game ban for spitting toward Raiders players, so he is ineligible for the Ravens game. Joe Brady has indicated the Bills don't plan to release him.

Brady said WR DJ Moore (shoulder) and DT Ed Oliver (knee) were both 'close' to playing in Vegas and he hopes they're near full health for Baltimore. With Gardner-Johnson out, Damar Hamlin is expected to start at safety alongside Cole Bishop.

news.h: Allen, Cook lead bye-week report card
news.b: Josh Allen leads the NFL with 17 total touchdowns (9 passing, 8 rushing) through six games, and James Cook ranks third in the league with 627 rushing yards. Greg Rousseau has six sacks and a league-high 39 pressures per PFF, while Tyler Bass is 13-for-13 on field goals.
New England lost 30-24 at Chicago on Thursday night, dropping to 4-3 and leaving Buffalo (5-1) a game and a half up in the AFC East during its bye. The Jets (2-4) host winless Miami on Sunday.

source: Buffalobills.com (Oct 19), Yahoo Sports/Athlon and Bills On SI (Oct 20–21), Heavy (Oct 22), ESPN odds; checked Oct 24, 2026. Refreshes with the daily update.
